parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=10: val_bpb 0.8483 -> 0.8419. Depth scaling continues to work, even if slightly less dramatic than earlier jumps. It seems we are approaching a point of diminishing returns or need to refine other params. Next: testing DEPTH=12 to see if capacity scaling can still push us lower.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 10 to 12 to continue exploring capacity scaling, building on the success of previous depth increases.
